meta.title: Anger Barometer
meta.subtitle: A rough measure of anger over the last 4 weeks.
meta.description: Five questions about how often and how strongly anger showed up, how long it lasted, whether it turned aggressive and whether it hurt relationships. Score from 5 to 25. This is the app's own rough measure, not a validated instrument. It's meant for comparing yourself with yourself over time.
meta.disclaimer: This tool supports self-reflection and tracking change. It does not diagnose and does not replace a consultation with a professional.

consent.title: Consent and disclaimer
consent.body: I understand this is a self-reflection tool, not a clinical test, and I agree to store my results locally on this device.

interpretation.low: Anger rarely caused you trouble over the last weeks.
interpretation.elevated: Anger came often or strongly enough to have a cost. It's worth looking at what triggers it.
interpretation.high: Anger was frequent, strong or hurt relationships. It's worth giving it attention and considering professional support.

notice: If anger turns into violence or someone feels unsafe around you, look for professional help. The app can support work on anger, but it can't replace that.

items.anger_01: Over the last 4 weeks, anger showed up often.
items.anger_02: My anger could get very strong.
items.anger_03: Anger lingered for a long time, even after the situation was over.
items.anger_04: I sometimes expressed anger in ways that hurt others or damaged things (shouting, insults, slamming).
items.anger_05: Anger harmed my relationships with loved ones, at work or with other people.
